children.value: > Fact From Story: The 31-year-old co-founded FTX in 2019; within a few years the once third-largest crypto exchange’s valuation hit $32 billion at its peak.
> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried was even compared to Warren Buffet and many called him the white horse of crypto
> > > > > > Fact From Story: Within two years, more than 80 investors provided about $2 billion in capital to FTX, helping Bankman-Fried propel his vision into a reality.
> > > > > > Fact From Story: He co-founded FTX in 2019 as a complement to Alameda, to help bring in revenue and liquidity for the trading arm.
> > > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Investors are more likely to invest in something that shows promise.
> > Fact From Story: Before FTX, Bankman-Fried co-founded crypto-trading firm Alameda Research in 2017.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Being compared to Warren Buffet is generally a positive thing.
> Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried is in court for alleged fraud and money laundering while leading crypto exchange FTX and sister company Alameda.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO is responsible for the direction and success of their company.
